sections.Profile:
The On Beam pinball machine, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in August 1969, features a space exploration theme with artwork by Christian Marche and Jerry Kelley. Designed by Bob Jonesi, this electro-mechanical game accommodates a single player and includes a mechanical reel display for scoring. A total of 1,150 units were produced. The game is noted for its unique cabinet artwork, which was influenced by Bally's earlier machine Cosmos
